subject: Hosted API baseline & competitor cost comparison
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa@cloudcourier.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:18:00Z
Subject: Hosted API baseline & competitor cost comparison

Hi Evelyn,

We are evaluating hosted inference providers and I wanted to get a clean baseline from Redwood for hosted API pricing and any standard volume discounts. Specifically, our procurement lead asked for a short competitor comparison (OpenAI / Anthropic / Together / AWS) on blended token economics so we can map to our current invoices.

High level context: CloudCourier runs a customer-facing agent platform (real-time chat + short generation) — we estimate starting volumes at ~50M tokens/month (split between prompts & completions). Key asks:
- Baseline per-1K prompt and per-1K completion rates for Redwood hosted API today
- Any published volume discount bands (and thresholds) you can share
- Whether Redwood can provide a blended $/1K token estimate compared to OpenAI/Anthropic/Together/AWS (we can share our current invoices)
- Any limits or additional costs (egress, region pricing, sustained-concurrency surcharges)
- Timeline for a PoC and whether there are trial credits or promotional matches for first 3 months

If possible please include a short note on how Dedicated/Private options change unit economics versus hosted. I can share our May invoice and rough traffic breakdown.

Thanks — Lisa

Lisa Chen
Head of ML Engineering | CloudCourier
lisa@cloudcourier.com
[Attachment: current_invoice_may2027.pdf (pdf)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@cloudcourier.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API baseline & competitor cost comparison

Hi Lisa — great to connect. Thanks for the context. I attached our standard hosted API rate card and a short note that maps typical competitor public rates to a blended comparison. Quick answers up front:

- Baseline (hosted API, public):
  • Prompt tokens: $0.025 / 1k tokens
  • Completion tokens: $0.05 / 1k tokens
- Volume discounts: tiered at 5M, 25M, 100M tokens / month (examples in the attached rate card). Typical committed tiers start at 25M.
- Blended pricing: we included a sample blended calc in the competitor note; depending on prompt/completion mix we generally land between $0.035–0.045 / 1k tokens when matching recent market offers.
- Extra costs: egress in non-us regions, premium routing for sub-10ms SLOs, and Private deployments have an infra surcharge but provide much lower per-token CPU/GPU costs at high volumes. Details in the rate card.
- PoC: we can provide up to 100k tokens in onboarding credits and a 2-week priority onboarding window.

Could you confirm the prompt/completion split and concurrency (per-region)? That will let me run a tighter blended match. Also looping Monica (sales ops) so she can attach a draft pricing worksheet if you want formal pricing.

Attaching: redwood_hostedapi_ratecard_Q2_2027.pdf, competitor_rate_parity_note.txt

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_hostedapi_ratecard_Q2_2027.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: competitor_rate_parity_note.txt (txt)]

From: Lisa Chen <lisa@cloudcourier.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-08T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API baseline & competitor cost comparison

Thanks Evelyn — quick clarifications below:
- Expected monthly volume (steady-state): 50M tokens total (approx 35M prompt, 15M completion)
- Concurrency: typical 3 concurrent inference streams for our public endpoints; peak spikes up to ~12 concurrent for short windows
- Region: US primary, EU for a small subset later in year

For context on incumbent pricing: our current provider charges roughly $0.03 / 1k prompt, $0.06 / 1k completion. If Redwood can present an equivalent blended rate that is ~ at or below $0.045 / 1k we will have a clear negotiating path with procurement.

I attached our May invoice so you can see the mix. Also open to a 12-month commit if the economics are right.

Lisa

Evelyn — good opportunity. Recommendation:
- Offer an introductory promotional blended rate of $0.04 / 1k tokens for the first 3 months (to match competitive splits) contingent on a 12-month minimum 50M token commitment. After promo, step down to committed tier pricing as per rate card (examples: $0.035 / 1k at 50M+ with certain batching/latency configs).
- Include a one-time 50k token PoC credit and waived onboarding fee.
- If they convert to Dedicated/Private within 90 days, provide a one-time migration credit that offsets first-month reserved capacity.

Conditions: require standard data processing addendum, and include a scheduling SLA for onboarding. Ops note: Monica, please validate margin at $0.04 blended for 50M; if margin < target, propose a $0.042 fallback.

Approve for Evelyn to communicate with CloudCourier. Marcus
